name: ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 v1.1
psram: 8 MB octal on N8R8/N16R8 modules, none on N8/N16
usb: USB-C, native USB port labelled USB
notes: Reference board. Tested on hardware with the default build on a VCC-GND YD-ESP32-S3 (a DevKitC-1 clone, N16R8). WROOM-1 modules with 8 or 16 MB quad flash; WROOM-2 (octal flash) variants are not supported.
